delay.title: TV delay
delay.help: Hold the page, the team radio and your automations back to match your TV or stream. Everyone in the house shares this setting.

spoiler.help: Hides the outcome of the latest Grand Prix weekend until you reveal it.
spoiler.standingsCap: No-spoiler mode: the standings before this weekend.

common.unavailable: The data source did not answer. It may be busy or down; try again in a minute.

common.title: Live Board

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty: No calendar for this season yet.

results.title: Results
results.empty: No race of this season has results yet.
results.archive: Detail from F1's session archive: the first opening downloads it once.
results.notArchived: F1's archive has no detail for this race.

standings.title: Standings
standings.empty: No standings for this season yet.

live.noNext: The season is over. See you next year.
live.syncingHelp: The first data is held back {n} s, like everything else.
live.hiddenHelp: {meeting} — {session} is hidden. Turn the mode off when you have caught up.
live.stale: Live feed lost — reconnecting. The data is {n} s old.
live.lost: Live feed lost for over a minute. Nothing here is live.
live.noRadio: No team radio published for this session.
live.mapLocked: The live map needs an F1TV subscription. An administrator can add a token in this panel's Settings (the gear icon).
live.mapNoData: No position data from F1 for this session.
live.mapDrawing: Drawing the circuit from the cars' positions…
live.mapNotEnabled: The live track map is not enabled in this Home Assistant.
live.mapToken: F1 did not accept the F1TV token, so there is no map. An administrator can add a new one in this panel's Settings (the gear icon).
live.autoStart: It starts by itself at the next session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.running: Connected to F1's live timing for the session under way.
settings.waiting: Ready: it connects by itself when a session starts.
settings.pausedHelp: Paused: nothing connects to F1 and nothing live is written to disk.
settings.autoStartHelp: Live timing turns itself on when a session is about to start. Pausing it during a session holds until the next one.
settings.f1tvHelp: Only the live track map needs F1TV; everything else works without an account.
settings.tokenReplace: Paste a new token to replace the current one
settings.tokenSteps: Sign in at f1tv.formula1.com, open the browser's developer tools → Application (Storage in Firefox) → Cookies, and copy the value of loginSession. It is renewed automatically; it is never shown again after saving.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove the F1TV token? The live map stops until a new one is added.
settings.entitiesHelp: Use them in automations and dashboards: flags, safety car, penalties and the stewards' decisions have their own entities. They follow the TV delay and no-spoiler mode.

errors.token_invalid: That does not look like an F1TV token. Paste the whole value of the loginSession cookie.
errors.token_expired: This token has expired or expires within minutes. Sign in to F1TV again and copy a fresh one.
errors.token_no_subscription: This F1TV account has no active subscription.
errors.remove_failed: The token could not be removed. Try again in a moment.
